title: The bill of consequences a feature adds

rows: The plan asked for pyyaml, but the candidate reads its config with the standard json module — the bill caught a dependency nothing actually uses.
config keys are read at start-up; a bad value stops the service at boot, not mid-payment

gap: An interactive before/after dependency review is the remaining piece; the bill and its real finding are here.
honesty: A local test migration is never sold as production-proof — the recovery limits say exactly what a restart does.
